data.body_html:
Imagine dropping to one knee as the sun sinks into the Mediterranean, painting the sky in shades of gold and rose. A romantic proposal sunset cruise in Marbella 2039 offers exactly that—a private, unforgettable moment on the water, far from the crowds. Departing from glamorous Puerto Banús, you'll sail along the Costa del Sol with your partner, champagne in hand, as La Concha mountain glows in the distance. Whether you choose an intimate 2-hour charter or a longer voyage, we handle every detail so you can focus on the big question.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise for Your Proposal?

A sunset cruise combines privacy, natural beauty, and luxury. Instead of a crowded restaurant or beach, you have the entire yacht to yourselves—just the sea, the sky, and your loved one. The golden hour light creates stunning photo opportunities, and the gentle motion of the boat adds a touch of romance. Our skippers know the best spots for sunset views, from the cliffs of Cala del Faro to the calm waters off Cabopino. Plus, with all drinks and snacks included, you can relax and enjoy the moment without worrying about logistics.

Our Yachts for a Romantic Proposal

We offer a range of private yachts departing from Puerto Banús, all fully crewed and equipped for your special evening. For an intimate proposal, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests) are perfect—both start at €749 for 2 hours (skipper, drinks, and VAT included). If you're celebrating with a larger group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) offers a spacious flybridge and a free jet ski, from €4,719 for 4 hours. For something in between, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 guests) provides ample deck space and a luxurious interior. All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. No hidden costs.

What to Expect on Your Proposal Cruise

Your cruise begins at Puerto Banús, where you'll be welcomed aboard by your skipper. After a safety briefing, you'll motor out into the Mediterranean, passing the iconic port and the Golden Mile. The skipper will anchor at a scenic spot—perhaps near Cala Cortés or off the coast of Estepona—where you can enjoy drinks and snacks as the sun sets. We recommend bringing a small speaker for your favourite songs, and we can arrange rose petals, a personalised sign, or a photographer on request (additional cost). After the proposal, toast with champagne or cava as the stars appear. The return to port is relaxed, with the lights of Marbella twinkling in the distance.

How to Plan Your Perfect Sunset Proposal

Timing is key. Sunset in Marbella varies by season: around 18:30 in December and 21:30 in June. We suggest a 2-hour cruise departing 30 minutes before sunset to capture the golden hour and the afterglow. Book at least two weeks in advance, especially during summer (June-September) when demand is high. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss your ideas—we can arrange flowers, a custom menu, or a private chef. For a truly bespoke experience, consider the Marbella Romantic Sunset Cruise Proposal: 2039 Experience package, which includes premium champagne, a dedicated host, and a guaranteed sunset spot.
